main_text.l: Sub Parlamento Tolosano Diæceses sunt xxxi: In
II Auscensis, Auch. Inepte Vulgo Ecclesiastico Auxitanus Archiepiscopus, pro Auscitorum aut Auscorum.
III Tolosanus. Nova Metropolis detracta ex Metropoli Narbonensi, Tolosæ.
IV Sancti Pontij Tomeriarum, Saint Pont de Tomieres.
V Aletensis, Alet: pro quo in Decreto
& Decretalibus aliquando perperam editum est, Arelatensis.
XIII Aniciensis, Le puy en Velay.
XV Vabrensis, Vabres. Novus Episcopatus ex Monasterio, abscissus à Rutenensi.
Episcopatus vii, novi sub Metropoli nova Tolosa, ex Monasteriis, detractis de diversis; partim singuli de singulis; partim singuli de pluribus;
XIX Sancti Papuli, Saint P. pol.
XX Montalbanensis, Montauban. S. Theodard de Montauban.
XXIV Convenensis, Saint Bertrand de Comenge.
XXV Consarannensis, Saint Legier de Coserans.
Sub Parlamento Gratianopolitano Diæceses sunt vii: In
eo lege quæ sequenti dicam Capite.

page.notes: Marginal labels and small side numerals (10, 40, 50) are reproduced where they stand. Several roman numerals and place names in the lists are uncertain due to the faded scan; XXVIII appears as XXIIX in one line and may be a printing error. Some place names (e.g. Montpeliter, Lombés) are read with doubt. Catchword "Episcopatus" at lower right treated as a catchword.
